title: Design the wordless sign that the pouch is full
tier_reason: The new refusal is the only part of this change a pre-reader has to understand unaided.
ask: Accepted “What harvest-as-seed costs us in the simulation, honestly”. The new refusal is the only part of this change a pre-reader has to understand unaided.
first_action: Design the icon and feedback for a harvest refused because the pouch is full, per the S-7 wordless rule; harvest is the reward verb and gaining a silent 'no' would repeat the unexplained-refusal problem a real session already surfaced.
source_message: Accepted “What harvest-as-seed costs us in the simulation, honestly”.
result:
I designed the wordless "pouch is full" refusal and wrote it into `docs/design/11-ux-ui.md`, in the same place the game's other three refusal icons (no seeds, no water, no energy) already live.

**What it does:** when harvest-as-seed lands and a full pouch blocks a harvest, the tile gets the same treatment those three already get — a sideways wobble, the "nope" sound, and a small icon over the tile — not the calm, silent acknowledgment a genuinely fine state like a full watering can gets. A blocked harvest means the reward she just grew is sitting there and she can't take it; that's a real problem and has to read as one, especially since a real playtest already logged 17 silent refusals out of 27 taps before this vocabulary existed. The ripe crop stays on the tile — nothing is lost, only delayed.

**The icon:** the same drawstring pouch already drawn for "no seeds," shown at its opposite state — round and straining, with a wheat head and the corner of a tomato caught where they don't fit. Same object, two states a kid already reads off a real bag (flat-empty, round-too-full), so it costs nothing to learn on top of the icon that already exists. It needs one new 16×16 cell on `tool_icons.png`.

**What I didn't do:** draw the actual pixel art, or touch any code. The sim doesn't have a `pouch_full` reason yet — that's Tomás's queued sim work — and the icon asset is Yuki's. I wrote the spec precisely enough that both can build to it without a second design pass, and I flagged one specific risk in the doc: the last time a refusal reason existed on only one of the two code paths (the sim's actual check and the router's pre-tap check), its icon silently dropped. `pouch_full` needs to come out of both, or this ships silent the same way.

One thing worth knowing: nobody ever wrote the harvest-as-seed decision itself into `DECISION_LOG.md` or `DESIGNER_QUEUE.md`, even though you accepted it — it exists only inside a work-item file. I'm flagging that below rather than fixing it myself, since it's four people's work to reconcile, not mine.

findings.fix: Quote it as recorded — 17 of 27 refusals gave no reason — and stop using it as evidence for refuse-over-acknowledge; it is evidence that unexplained feedback hurts either way
